bible.title: The Oath That Held
bible.kernel: A tarred token points into the old-growth. The company must fetch the woman who still keeps an oath.

cast.name: Arlette
cast.who: Riverfront performer who fled after breaking a toll oath, restless and quick-tongued.
cast.want: to keep the oath's token safe until she can honor the pledge

cast.name: Daighre
cast.who: Old-growth burner who enforces pledges with tar and blunt law.
cast.want: to hold Arlette until the pledge is fulfilled at the root-circle

bible.situation: The fort contracted the company to bring Arlette to its gate to answer for breaking a toll oath. She fled west into the Old-growth and left a tar-stained token behind.
bible.goal: to bring Arlette to the fort to answer for breaking a toll oath
arc: Search Tarfen Crossing for signs the fugitive passed, following the fort's lead → yields: a tarred ribbon stamped with an old oath-mark.
Follow the ribbon to Blackvat Hollow and press the tar-makers about who brands that mark → yields: a broken spindle scored with the name Daighre and a smear leading deeper west.

Take the spindle to Fenwatch Hut and question the wood-cutter who trades with the tarworks, using the smear → yields: the wood-cutter's warning that Daighre claims Arlette for an oath at Glimmerroot and a splintered pledge-talon as proof.
Push into Glimmerroot and force the root-circle where Daighre holds watch, using the pledge-talon to demand surrender → yields: Arlette handed to the fort at its outer gate.
tensions: Daighre enforces old oaths and will not hand over a bound woman without a spectacle or price
tar-smear trails are easy to lose in the moss and the company works on a tight season before the lord's inspectors arrive
the Old-growth's law and its elven neighbors frown on hauling pledged business into the fort
openDirections: Arlette's fate after delivery — whether she is kept, sold, or bargained into company service — will depend on the fort's purse and the company's willingness to bargain.
bible.stakeIfLost: If Arlette is not returned, the fort will lose its river-toll right when the lord strips its license and hands the toll-house to a rival, cutting the fort's income.
bible.arrival: turned up with the tally-carts · named a price before being asked

shipped.title: Tracks at Tarfen Crossing
shipped.situation: A riverfront performer, Arlette, turned up with the tally-carts and named a price before being asked. The fort wants Arlette returned to answer for breaking a toll oath. If Arlette is not returned the fort will lose its river-toll right when the lord strips its license and hands the toll-house to a rival, cutting the fort's income. This step must find signs that she passed Tarfen Crossing, the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company. A burner may be holding her near the root-circle until the pledge is fulfilled.
shipped.job: Find signs at Tarfen Crossing whether Arlette passed that way.
